case_title: Amitava Banerjee v. State of West Bengal
high_court_outcome: Upheld the order of the trial court
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were acquaintances who had a prior interaction. The victim was last seen with the accused in a park around the time of the incident. The accused was seen with the victim in a jungle area near the time of the victim's death. A bicycle owned by the accused was recovered from the jungle near where the victim's body was found. A spade, which the accused had borrowed, was also found near the location. The victim's body was discovered in a ditch with signs of strangulation. The accused was identified by multiple witnesses and was seen without his chappals and bicycle at the time of the discovery. The presence of a newspaper and a 'Sutli' near the ditch and on the victim's body were also noted as significant evidence.
